details.description: codex-mini is Azure OpenAI's hosting of OpenAI's codex-mini-latest, a fast reasoning model fine-tuned from o4-mini specifically for use in the Codex CLI; for general-purpose API use OpenAI's own docs recommend starting with GPT-4.1 instead. It takes text and image input, supports reasoning tokens, structured outputs and function/tool calling, and its training data runs through mid-2024. OpenAI removed the equivalent codex-mini-latest model from its own direct API on February 12, 2026, replacing it with gpt-5-codex-mini, though the Azure snapshot in this catalog is tracked separately.
advantages: A fast reasoning model fine-tuned from o4-mini specifically for use in the Codex CLI (OpenAI codex-mini-latest model page).
Supports reasoning tokens, structured outputs and function/tool calling alongside text and image input (OpenAI codex-mini-latest model page).
Azure lists this snapshot's training data as current through May 31, 2024 (Microsoft Foundry models page).
disadvantages: OpenAI deprecated and removed the equivalent codex-mini-latest model from its own direct API on February 12, 2026, recommending gpt-5-codex-mini instead (OpenAI Deprecations page).
OpenAI recommends starting with GPT-4.1 rather than codex-mini-latest for direct API use outside the Codex CLI (OpenAI codex-mini-latest model page).
Narrow, CLI-focused model with a mid-2024 knowledge cutoff and no audio or video input (OpenAI codex-mini-latest model page).
use_cases: Fast reasoning assistance for code questions and tasks inside the Codex CLI
Agentic coding workflows that call functions or tools during a session

notes: Confirmed the catalog's 2026-11-15 deprecation_date against Azure's Model retirement schedule, which lists codex-mini (2025-05-16) with Deprecated lifecycle status and a 2026-11-15 retirement date. OpenAI's direct API separately retired the equivalent codex-mini-latest model on 2026-02-12 (replacement: gpt-5-codex-mini), which Azure's current model page does not mention, so the two hosts are on different schedules. OpenAI's own model page states codex-mini-latest is usable only via the Responses API, while the catalog's endpoints list both /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses; kept the catalog's endpoint list. max_input_tokens (200000) and max_output_tokens (100000) in facts match Azure's published figures for this snapshot.
